label: Loom Video Downloader
title: Loom Video Downloader: Videos, Transcripts & Folders
metaDescription: Download Loom videos and transcripts (SRT, VTT, TXT) with metadata from single videos or whole folders, in bulk.
intro: Paste Loom video or folder links and get the videos, transcripts (SRT, VTT, TXT or XML) and metadata, in bulk.
useCases: Archive a team's Loom library before a plan change
Turn walkthrough videos into searchable text
Move training videos into another platform

faq.q: Can you get Loom transcripts through an API?
faq.a: Loom does not offer a public API for downloading the transcripts of shared videos. Run this actor through the Apify API with Loom links and you get the transcripts back as files and JSON.
